channel.title: World News
channel.description: Aggregated headlines linking to original publishers

item.title: Trump says he has 'every intention' to keep Hegseth
item.description: President Donald Trump said he intends to keep Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in his job, as Rep. Massie, prepares to introduce an impeachment resolution against him.

item.title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
item.description: A prosecutor described Brand as a ruthless, calculating, manipulative "sexual predator." Brand, 51, denied the charges, saying he had never forced anyone to do something against their will.

item.title: Dow plunges 1,200 points, shedding most of midterm results stock rally
item.description: The selloff came a day after the Dow soared more than 1,500 points.

item.title: US midterms: 'Donald Trump's wings have been more than clipped'
item.description: US President Donald Trump faced a radically transformed and hostile political landscape after Democrats seized both the House of Representatives and the Senate in Tuesday's (November 3) midterms. The result was a personal humiliation for the 80-year-old Trump, leaving him as a lame duck president for the remaining two years of his term. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert has more.

item.title: Global travel sector grows despite headwinds
item.description: The global tourism sector is growing, despite conflicts and economic uncertainty. That's the finding of a new report by World Travel Market, which says the number of international arrivals is set to hit a record 1.57 billion in 2026.

item.title: Europe: Dozens of flights diverted following bomb threats
item.description: Hoax bomb threats hit at least 27 affected flights around Europe this week.

item.title: Henry Nowak's killer has life sentence increased
item.description: Henry Nowak's killer has had his life sentence increased on the day his bid to reduce it failed.

item.title: 'Identity crisis': Can Democrats 'deliver' following their 'historic', once in a generation victory?
item.description: A historic Democratic electoral breakthrough has transformed the American political landscape. For Laurie Dundon, Senior Associate Fellow at the European Leadership Network and former US diplomat, the central question is whether the Democratic Party can convert electoral momentum into coherent governance. "Can they deliver?" Dunden examines the apparent disintegration of Donald Trump's 2024 MAGA coalition alongside the Democratic Party's continuing ideological struggle between its progressive and centrist wings. Ahead of 2028, Dunden cautions against seeing Trump as a lame duck: "Trump is never going to stop being Trump." The resulting struggle over congressional spending powers, presidential vetoes, tariffs and investigations promises to be a delicate dance to watch".

item.title: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
item.description: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.

item.title: WATCH: New 911 calls and bodycam video released in Citibank Center shooting in Tampa
item.description: A Citibank employee was shot and killed at a business complex in Florida on Wednesday, according to local authorities and company officials.

item.title: Israel's main Arab list backs Eisenkot to form government after election
item.description: Israel's largest Arab party grouping said Thursday it would recommend opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government, potentially bolstering his bid after Arab-majority lists won a record 19 seats in last week's election.

item.title: WATCH: Eiffel Tower closes amid protests in Paris
item.description: ABC News’ Tom Soufi Burridge reports from Paris, where tens of thousands of police officers have been deployed to help maintain law and order.

item.title: Bringing the magic of Harry Potter to life through music
item.description: In this edition of Entre Nous, we meet Timothy Henty, the British conductor bringing the magic of Harry Potter to life in Paris. As part of the Harry Potter Film Concert Series, he leads more than 80 musicians in a spectacular live orchestral performance, offering audiences a unique opportunity to experience one of cinema's most beloved stories like never before.

item.title: British comedian Russell Brand found guilty of rape, sexual assault
item.description: A London jury on Thursday convicted British comedian and actor Russell Brand of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.

item.title: France faces new protests as government seeks to prevent violence
item.description: France faces new protests as the government seeks to prevent a repeat of October unrest. Protesters demand better public services, including education, and also critique the rising cost-of-living. FRANCE 24's Claire Paccalin reports from the ground.

item.title: French bank hit by cyberattack, hackers steal $100 million
item.description: French regional bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa said Wednesday it had been hit by a cyberattack that led to fraudulent transfers worth around 100 million euros ($112 million). The bank said the attack, which has since been "contained", allowed hackers to access its own accounts and transfer funds to other banks. Customer accounts were not affected, and no losses were reported by clients.

item.title: South African star Zolani Mahola: From 'Waka Waka' with Shakira to 'People Power'
item.description: From the global success of "Waka Waka" to her forthcoming second solo album "People Power", South Africa's Zolani Mahola has built a career around the power of music to bring people together.

item.title: 'It's fascinating to see a human becoming a person': Author Clémentine Goldszal
item.description: What is life like for a newly born, premature or sick baby? These are the questions tackled by a French journalist in her first ever book. Clémentine Goldszal asks what it means to be rushed from the delivery room to the neonatal intensive care unit, and what is means to enter the world before you are ready. Goldszal's book is entitled "Newborn: Inside the World of Neonatal Care". She spoke to us in Perspective.

item.title: Bent on leaving his mark: Trump's proposed 'Triumphal Arch' sparks backlash
item.description: Since his return to power, US President Donald Trump has been intent on reshaping the nation's capital Washington, seeking to leave his name and mark on it. After his involvement with the Kennedy Center, the White House ballroom and the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, Trump is now particularly keen on building a 250-foot (79-metre) "Triumphal Arch" – a project he claims is intended to honour the 250th anniversary of the United States.

item.title: What comes next for Democrats after midterm election victory?
item.description: With the US midterms over, Democrats are turning to what could become one of their most crowded and unpredictable presidential primaries in decades – a 2028 contest ​likely to expose the party's divide over how to win back the White House. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert has more.

item.title: Multiple flights in Europe diverted because of bomb threats after earlier hoaxes
item.description: Multiple flights in Europe made emergency landings on Thursday after being diverted because of bomb threats. The incidents followed hoax bomb threats earlier this week that prompted searches, diversions and in one case a military escort.

item.title: France: High schools blocked again as students reject government responses as 'meaningless'
item.description: 🇫🇷 Students are blocking their schools and universities across France again this Thursday, November 5, despite the government’s response, which they deem insufficient.

item.title: WATCH: The wide-ranging reactions to election night
item.description: After an Election Day so pivotal that votes were even being cast from space, there were many expressive reactions shared online.

item.title: PM reviewing decision to give UK military satellite system contract to US firm
item.description: Andy Burnham must settle a bitter battle on Earth between rival American and European companies over the future in space of a critical UK military satellite system.

item.title: Teens worldwide aren't getting enough exercise -- especially girls
item.description: A new study looks at the recommended amount of daily exercise for adolescents — and how few are getting it.

item.title: Farewell Botox, heels and big hair: Is this the end of MAGA women?
item.description: PRESS REVIEW – Thursday, November 5: "Loser" and "Reborn in the USA" are just some of the headlines dominating the international press after the Democrats stomped to victory in the US midterm elections. What impact will their success have on the rest of Donald Trump's presidency? How will he govern with a Democratic-controlled Congress? These are just some of the burning questions after that vote. Also, do the midterm results signal the end of the MAGA woman and the "Mar-a-Lago face"?

item.title: Election 2026 live results: Democrat Colom leads Republican Hyde-Smith by 1,138 votes
item.description: House Democrats will hold leadership elections on Nov. 18.

item.title: Sen. Gillibrand says Democrats must end Iran war, hold Trump accountable. But how?
item.description: Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand spoke with Morning Edition about Democrats' priorities, from lowering costs to ending the Iran war. But questions remain about how they'll deliver.

item.title: Bomb threats cause major flight disruptions across Europe
item.description: Bomb ​threats forced airliners to make unplanned landings across Europe on Thursday morning, the latest in a series of threats targeting flights in Europe. While no country has attributed blame for the threats, they come at a time ​when European officials have been blaming both Russia and Iran for what they describe as "hybrid attacks" and acts of sabotage. Moscow and Tehran both deny any such campaign. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Philip Turle tells us more.

item.title: US midterms: Elon Musk fails $440 million bet as Republicans lose
item.description: The 2026 midterm elections were the most expensive on record, with nearly 12 billion dollars spent during the campaign. Tech tycoon Elon Musk was by far the largest individual donor ever, injecting over 440 million dollars of his money to support the GOP. Tuesday's resounding Democratic victory showed the limits of his money, power and influence.

item.title: Hong Kong activist jailed for 10 more years for collusion with foreign forces
item.description: Hong Kong democracy activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 more years in jail on Thursday for colluding with foreign powers, the second time he has been penalised under the city's national security law. Hong, 30, is one of the most globally recognised faces of Hong Kong's pro-democracy movement and has already spent almost six years behind bars. He is now not due for release until late 2036.

item.title: Route du Rhum 2026: Sailors forced to abandon race for various reasons
item.description: The 2026 Route du Rhum is continuing to deliver one setback after another since Sunday’s start in Saint-Malo. From boats capsizing to sailors being forced to abandon the race, the favourites are dropping out one by one. But how do so many boats suffer damage so early in the race?

item.title: US Midterms: Democrats say ready to negotiate and promise big changes
item.description: US Democrats are promising to leverage their landslide election win to bring down living costs and hold President Donald Trump's administration to account. They are set to take control of both chambers of Congress in January, but delivering on their agenda could mean striking deals with the very president they have pledged to rein in.

item.title: Houthi missiles fired at Medina intercepted, Saudi coalition says
item.description: A ballistic missile fired at the Saudi city of Medina, one of Islam's holiest cities, was intercepted Thursday, a spokesman for the Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Houthi rebels said. The announcement came shortly after the kingdom's civil defence agency warned of potential danger around the strategic port of Yanbu.

item.title: Who won the redistricting war? So far, it looks like Democrats
item.description: Dems were able to keep seats that Republicans redrew to make them GOP-friendly.

item.title: South Africans eager to vote as local elections put failing services in focus
item.description: South Africans voted on Wednesday, November 4, in local elections. Nearly 30 million people were eligible to cast their ballots, with corruption, failing infrastructure and the deterioration of essential services among the key issues shaping the vote. FRANCE 24's correspondent Eunice Masson reports from the ground.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo bows out from national team with emotional message
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football.

item.title: Black candidates from both parties made history in midterm elections
item.description: Black candidates from both political parties made history in 2026, with six governors set to serve across U.S. states and new key milestones in Congress.

item.title: 'I'll die in prison,' says man who drugged and raped wife in case likened to Gisele Pelicot
item.description: A man who drugged and raped his wife for more than 20 years in a case likened to Gisele Pelicot expects to "die in prison for what he has done", a court has heard.

item.title: Trump's arch is on the verge of federal approval. But a judge could block construction
item.description: A federal panel will meet to consider the arch for final approval on Thursday, and the government said it may begin construction later that same day. Critics hope a judge will intervene last-minute.

item.title: As budgets tighten, people are breaking out their library cards
item.description: Some Americans squeezed by high prices are relying more on their local libraries for things like books, streaming services and high-priced items like musical instruments and sewing machines.

item.title: The South flexes political power in midterms, sets regional influence in 2028 election
item.description: Tuesday's dramatic midterm results have transformed the electoral map, ensuring the path to future power for Democrats and Republicans must run through the South and its diverse voting population.

item.title: Does the blue wave mean lower gasoline and diesel prices soon? Don't hold your breath
item.description: A new Democratic majority in Congress could pressure the president to end the war in Iran. But it will be harder for them to directly affect fuel prices, which are tied to a complex international oil market.

item.title: Poundland owner turns to Thames Water creditors' lobbying firm as political heat rises
item.description: The embattled owner of Poundland has parachuted in a team of top London lobbyists as it faces intensifying political pressure over the discount retailer's fate.

item.title: Vance blames Iran war for GOP's midterms defeat. Trump says he would 'do it again'
item.description: ABC News Voter poll found 34% of voters say the war was "crucial" to their vote.

item.title: 'Wild west' e-bike parking targeted
item.description: The government is seeking to end "wild west" e-bike parking and crack down on antisocial behaviour, such as riding on pavements.

item.title: Third person charged after police officer shot in foot in Nottingham
item.description: A 31-year-old woman has become the third person to be charged after a police officer was shot in the foot at a bus stop in Nottingham city centre.

item.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
item.description: The American singer-songwriter and poet visited with the American pope at the Vatican during a break between concert dates in Italy. The Vatican said the encounter was brief.

item.title: WATCH: David Muir on how a high school's auto shop is bringing Houston together
item.description: A student-run automotive shop has opened to the public – giving high schoolers hands-on experience with oil changes, tire rotations and multi-point inspections.

item.description: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: These candidates made history in the 2026 midterm elections
item.description: The midterms saw an expansion of representation among America's lawmakers, with several candidates celebrating groundbreaking wins.

item.title: WATCH: What to know after Democrats take back control of Congress
item.description: ABC News political contributors Amanda Renteria, a Democratic strategist, and Ramesh Ponnuru, editor of the National Review, share more about what's being called a "blue tsunami."

item.title: How Democrats flipped the Senate blue: The ABC News Voter Poll tells the story
item.description: ABC News projects that the Democratic Party has won a majority of seats in the U.S. Senate. Here’s how Democrats won some key races to get there.

item.title: WATCH: What to know about the Colorado congressional races
item.description: Democrat Jason Crow won his reelection for Colorado's 6th District, beating Republican challenger Jason Clark.

item.title: WATCH: Where do Republicans go from here?
item.description: ABC News contributors Cristina Tzintzun Ramirez, a Democratic strategist, and Sonny Joy Nelson, a former special assistant to President Trump, share their takeaways from last night's results.

item.title: New senator may have made a misstep in this viral video
item.description: All news is local now. I suppose that's one lesson from my encounter with Abdul El-Sayed.

item.title: WATCH: Candidates make midterms history
item.description: Keisha Lance Bottoms, David Crowley and Byron Donalds are projected to become the first Black governors elected in Georgia, Wisconsin and Florida.

item.title: Russia attacks Ukrainian aid hub in one of the deadliest strikes since war began
item.description: Russian strikes on an aid hub killed at least 40 people - making it one of Russia's deadliest attacks on Ukrainian civilians since the full-scale invasion began, officials said.

item.title: Voters elect female governors in 17 states, setting new record
item.description: Women will serve as governors for the first time in states including Tennessee and Georgia.

item.title: WATCH: Sen. Cory Booker sees 'big realignment' of US after Democrats' win
item.description: The New Jersey senator says Democrats now need to "deliver on the things that all of America wants right now."

item.title: Goalkeeper involved in collision with Spanish footballer who died releases statement
item.description: A goalkeeper involved in an on-field collision with a Spanish footballer who died says he is "going through the most difficult ‌days of his life".

item.title: WATCH: The many firsts in the midterms
item.description: Senior Political Correspondent Rachel Scott on a big night of firsts in the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Texas Democrat James Talarico speaks out after projected win against Paxton
item.description: Texas Senator-elect James Talarico says the Democratic sweep in the midterm elections goes beyond party lines.

item.title: Trump says he was 'a little bit surprised' after Democrats' big win in midterms
item.description: The president also said he was willing to work with Democrats.

item.title: WATCH: World leaders react to US midterm elections
item.description: ABC News' Maggie Rulli reports on the international reaction to a decisive rebuke of President Donald Trump.

item.title: WATCH: Martin Luther King Jr.'s granddaughter votes for 1st time
item.description: 18-year-old Yolanda Renee King, the granddaughter of Martin Luther King Jr. and Coretta Scott King, has cast a ballot in her very first election in Atlanta.

item.title: WATCH: Who turned out to vote, and why?
item.description: Senior Political Correspondent Rachel Scott breaks down what we know about the election results and the messages voters are sending.

item.title: Cyber attack threatens French blood banks
item.description: Blood bank sites in France are the latest to be hit by cyber attackers.

item.title: Spain's transport minister to resign after train crash killed 69 people
item.description: Spain's transport minister has said he will step down after two deadly train crashes in less than a year.

item.title: Bomb threats reported on multiple flights, including two from UK airports
item.description: At least seven flights, including two from the UK, have been affected by bomb threats, which caused unplanned landings and temporary airport closures.

item.title: Spanish footballer dies after on-field collision
item.description: Tenerife football player Jesus de Miguel has died after suffering a cardiac arrest following an on-field collision in a match on Monday.

item.title: British troops will be allowed to fire at Russian forces if attacked during multinational mission
item.description: British troops will be allowed to fire back at Russian forces if attacked as part of a multinational mission to secure any future peace in Ukraine, Western officials have said.

item.title: Channel 4 axes Married At First Sight UK after review
item.description: Married At First Sight UK will not return to Channel 4 following an external review launched in the wake of sexual misconduct allegations, the broadcaster has announced.
